title: AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate (DEA-C01)
summary: AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate (DEA-C01) is an associate-level certification for practitioners who build and operate on AWS. The exam is organised into 4 content domains: Data Ingestion and Transformation (34%), Data Store Management (26%), Data Operations and Support (22%), Data Security and Governance (18%). It is delivered as 50 scored questions and 15 unscored, scored against a scaled pass mark of 720 out of 1,000 with no per-domain minimum, so strength in one domain offsets weakness in another. Every task statement in this topic carries a MEDIUM and a HARD exercise batch, so the practice material follows the published outline of the exam rather than a general reading list. The statements here are taken from the exam guide, and the task list is the one AWS publishes: if AWS revises the guide, this topic is revised with it.
objectives: Data Ingestion and Transformation: the guide's domain 1 focus, examined through its 4 task statement(s).
Data Store Management: the guide's domain 2 focus, examined through its 4 task statement(s).
Data Operations and Support: the guide's domain 3 focus, examined through its 4 task statement(s).
Data Security and Governance: the guide's domain 4 focus, examined through its 5 task statement(s).
